verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site says users can extend its functionality with its API and webhooks to build custom workflows, so a first-party public API is claimed. The evidence is a single marketing line, though, and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec or llms.txt at the docs paths checked. That leaves how completely the API is documented and covered unproven. Missing for 10: API reference documentation describing endpoints and coverage, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, auth/token documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Gitea via the API.
